name: An engine the record and classifiers never hold up
what: Facts and reports reach the record on a path of their own, so a build that changes tens of thousands of files does not slow the engine. When a precaution makes a request wait for a classifier's opinion, only that request waits, and a classifier that crashes or runs long does not stop the engine.

suggest.why: Builds that change tens of thousands of files are everyday work for agents, and they must not slow every ask to Silo.
